question.text: Weekly USDINR options are available for how many serial weeks?

answer.text: 11 serial weekly contracts (excluding expiry week of monthly contracts)

explanation.text: The Logic: Weekly USDINR options offer 11 serial weekly contracts that expire on Friday, excluding the monthly-expiry week. Cross-currency options use monthly/quarterly cycles rather than weekly contracts. The Trap: The weekly cycle excludes the monthly-expiry week to avoid overlap with the monthly contract that already expires that Friday. Note: Limit the takeaway to the 11-week cycle and the monthly-expiry-week exclusion — the source pages support only this structural fact.
